meta_data.base_class: Retrieve the latest <weather phenomenon report> for a specific location, including relevant measurements and weather temperature - <weather phenomenon report> refers to automatically generated summaries about a specific type of weather event affecting a particular region, such as snowfall, rainfall, or fog.

tool_template.name: get_<class>_report
tool_template.description: Retrieves the latest <class> for a specified location, providing details about the conditions and weather temperature.

location.description: The location for which to get the <class> report, in the format of 'City, State'.

unit.description: The temperature unit to be used in the report. Options are 'celsius', 'fahrenheit', or 'kelvin'.

report_source.description: The data source or weather monitoring agency providing the latest <class> report, such as 'NOAA', 'Met Office', or 'Japan Meteorological Agency'.

include_alerts.description: If true, include any active weather alerts or warnings related to the <class> in the specified location.

detail_level.description: Specifies the level of detail to include in the <class> report. Options are 'summary', 'standard', or 'detailed'.

report_format.description: The preferred output format of the <class> report. Options are 'text', 'json', or 'graphical'.
